turns.reply:
I fixed the single-width fast-path regex in `rich/cells.py` by widening its ASCII range from `\u0020-\u006f` to `\u0020-\u007e`, so all printable ASCII now takes the fast path. The change is submitted. `tests/test_cells.py` passes (7 tests), and a quick check confirmed that strings containing `p` through `~` match the regex.

I did not confirm the exact upstream fix, so this is my reading of the issue. The range change is the one edit made.
